title: Sparkling Water 12-pack

drivers.name: Supplier delivery short
drivers.evidence: Planner note flags supply risk. No prior occurrence of this issue. No historical impact data. Only one past event with similar risk, but not measured. Noise-adjusted effect shrunk to x0.95.

adjustment.analysis: The baseline median is 95.8. No events, promotions, or price changes are scheduled. The recent price is unchanged at $6.17. However, the planner notes a supplier delivery short, which introduces supply risk. Historical data shows no recent disruptions, and the product has no strong seasonality in this period. The classical uplift model suggests no effect, and recent weeks (2026-09-28 to 2026-10-05) average 98 units — close to baseline. The delivery short is a new risk with no prior occurrence, so its impact is uncertain. We shrink the effect toward 1.0. A downside spread is warranted due to uncertainty in supply availability.

In the evidence below, 'vs baseline' = actual units / what this same baseline predicted for that week.
It is the multiplier that would have been right, so it maps directly onto median_multiplier.
This product's ordinary weeks already swing about +/-39% around the baseline, so a past effect smaller than that, seen only a few times, is mostly noise. The
'noise-adjusted estimate' is the effect shrunk toward x1.0 for that noise and the number of sightings.
